text.§1: If either of the spouses causes grave mental or physical danger to the other spouse or to the offspring or otherwise renders common life too difficult, that spouse gives the other a legitimate cause for leaving, either by decree of the local ordinary or even on his or her own authority if there is danger in delay.
text.§2: In all cases, when the cause for the separation ceases, conjugal living must be restored unless ecclesiastical authority has established otherwise.

location: Book IV, Part I, Title VII (Marriage), Chapter IX (The Separation of Spouses), Art. 2: Separation with the Bond Remaining
